headline: Proxy attendance for mid-day meal funds: Headmasters' salary to be deducted to recover penalty of ₹8 crore | Hindustan Times
description: The government has ordered the recovery of a Rs8.68-crore penalty from HMs. Of which, ₹4.21-crore (48%) has been recovered. More than 1,000 HMs have allegedly fudged the data since 2013, when the idea of penalty was first mooted by the state education department.
